name: temporal_proximity_disambiguation
description: Benchmark for verifying correct event filtering when the same actors appear in temporally close but distinct events

seed.description: Senate Republicans block bipartisan border security bill for second time in April 2026

simulated_candidates.title: Senate Republicans Block Border Security Bill for Second Time in April 2026
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: Senate Republicans blocked the bipartisan border security bill on a 60-vote threshold in April 2026, marking the second failed attempt this month.

simulated_candidates.title: GOP Senators Stand Firm Against Flawed Border Security Bill
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: Senate Republicans blocked the border security bill in April 2026, arguing it does not adequately address enforcement at the southern border.

simulated_candidates.title: Border Deal Collapses Again as Senate Republicans Block Vote
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: The bipartisan border security bill failed again in April 2026 when Senate Republicans blocked the legislation from reaching the 60-vote threshold.

simulated_candidates.title: Senate Republicans Block Continuing Resolution, Government Shutdown Looms
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: Senate Republicans blocked the continuing resolution in March 2026, bringing the government closer to a shutdown over defense spending disagreements.

simulated_candidates.title: Senate Republicans Filibuster Defense Authorization Bill
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: Senate Republicans filibustered the defense spending authorization bill in February 2026 over concerns about military readiness priorities.

simulated_candidates.title: Senate Fails to Advance Border Security Measure in January
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: The Senate failed to advance an earlier version of border security legislation in January 2026, setting the stage for renewed negotiations.

expectations.description: Multiple Senate Republican actions exist close in time. The system must use specific event markers (border security bill, April 2026) and must-not-have exclusions to filter out government shutdown, defense spending, and earlier border attempts.
